initiative.title: Progressive built-in charts
initiative.summary: Review every composition example and shape progressive built-in chart controls where composition is unnecessary.
initiative.next_action: Review the proposed shape and four milestones. Implementation remains unstarted; research PR will supply evidence and limits.

claims.statement: Users can reach advanced chart behavior progressively through built-in settings.
Composition should be required only for essential complexity beyond a coherent built-in chart.
Every composition example receives an evidence-backed justification and a specific built-in gap analysis.
Several composition examples may need only a few new settings or tweaks.
Do not turn this research request into application implementation or deletion of examples.

themes.statement: Progressive chart complexity without unnecessary composition authoring

shape.appetite: Four bounded milestones: existing counterparts, Scatter connections, interval repair, and Heatmap histories. Later capabilities require separate proof.
shape.problem: Users are sent to composition for operations that fit coherent built-in charts.
shape.recommended_shape: Contextual settings and named chart modes; composition retains independently scoped frames and authored arrangements.

first_proof.question: Can four existing public chart routes preserve the important comparison and exact evidence without composition?
first_proof.artifact: Four saved built-in counterparts, numerical/source checks, and browser evidence at three widths.
first_proof.decision_rule: Promote only counterparts whose values, sources, denominators, callouts, and save/text restoration pass; reopen any failed verdict.

Treating optional controls as a migration

milestones.title: Four existing routes become the primary analytical lessons
milestones.outcome: Users can learn four existing analytical routes through public controls.
milestones.proof: Public authoring; values and source/denominator traces; filters; saved and Dashboard text restoration.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Four added counterparts coexist with untouched composition examples.
milestones.rollback: Revert counterpart links and definitions; original examples remain.

milestones.title: Driving and grouped comparisons use ordered Scatter connections
milestones.outcome: Users can connect observations in explicit order and form grouped slope/paired comparisons.
milestones.proof: Driving reversal/null fixture; 34 tax and 67 occupation pairs; Pew role reversal/missing/duplicate cases; pointer/keyboard and persistence.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Connected mode is optional; ordinary Scatter remains the default.
milestones.rollback: Revert the optional connection/preset additions without converting existing compositions.

milestones.title: Supplied Line intervals preserve bounds, gaps, and evidence
milestones.outcome: Users can draw supplied intervals with correct bounds, runs, and source evidence.
milestones.proof: Extreme/null/reversed/duplicate-X bounds; exact band sources; clipping; saved/text round trips.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Existing Notes represents intervals; separate measure charts avoid a general facet dependency.
milestones.rollback: Revert interval-specific extension; preserve supplied fields and original examples.

milestones.title: Heatmap shows complete histories with stable color meaning
milestones.outcome: Users can reach every month/year and retain declared heat-color meaning.
milestones.proof: 12×72 and 51×85 coverage; absent/null/zero cells; exact date interval selection; fixed election colors; keyboard and restoration.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Heatmap remains a bounded matrix chart with explicit limits and color policy.
milestones.rollback: Revert optional axes/date/color controls; original composition reports remain available.

cut_line: Numeric normalized area and cohort summaries
Unit cells, rank, Horizon, geographic tiles
Rich tables, exact stream baseline, labels, and ordinary PNG export

open_decisions.fallback: Honest local viewport with complete keyboard coverage

open_decisions.fallback: Extend existing trace representation without a second system
